description: Long-chain action benchmark v1 for measuring whether Forge can continue real read/patch/verify tasks after long history pressure.

tasks.prompt: Continue the long-chain sample.txt repair from the recorded failure and finish with verification.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt contains beta-locked after long-chain failure repair
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; names = [event.get('name') for event in trace if event.get('event') == 'tool_executed']; assert 'beta-locked' in text; assert names[:3] == ['read_file', 'patch_file', 'run_shell']; assert report['tool_steps'] == 3; assert report['stop_reason'] == 'final_answer_returned'"

setup.last_failure: long-chain action failure expected beta-locked but saw beta
setup.next_step: read sample.txt, patch beta to beta-locked, then run verification

tasks.prompt: Re-anchor sample.txt before patching the current stale target.
tasks.expected_artifact: sample.txt uses current reanchored target instead of stale summary target
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; names = [event.get('name') for event in trace if event.get('event') == 'tool_executed']; assert report['prompt_metadata']['resume_status'] == 'partial-stale'; assert any(event.get('event') == 'checkpoint_created' and event.get('trigger') == 'freshness_mismatch' for event in trace); assert names[:2] == ['read_file', 'patch_file']; assert 'reanchored-target' in text; assert 'stale-target' not in text; assert 'placeholder-locked' not in text"

setup.summary: sample.txt stale summary says placeholder is the patch target

tasks.prompt: Continue the constrained README update. Do not modify the opening sentence; only replace the first Notes bullet with an allowed long-chain note.
tasks.expected_artifact: README opening sentence is preserved while allowed note is patched
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; text = Path('README.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; names = [event.get('name') for event in trace if event.get('event') == 'tool_executed']; assert 'This is a placeholder benchmark fixture.' in text; assert '- Long-chain constrained note is allowed.' in text; assert names[:2] == ['read_file', 'patch_file']; assert report['stop_reason'] == 'final_answer_returned'"

setup.constraint: do not modify the opening sentence
setup.stale_plan: old plan incorrectly suggested replacing the opening sentence

tasks.prompt: Continue the long-chain calculator bugfix, recover after failed verification, and finish only after tests pass.
tasks.expected_artifact: calculator.py is repaired after failed verification and passing verification is recorded
tasks.verifier: python3 -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; text = Path('calculator.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); report = json.loads(next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/report.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); ledger = report['bug_fix_ledger']; trace = [json.loads(line) for line in next(Path('.forge/runs').glob('*/trace.jsonl')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]; shell_count = sum(1 for event in trace if event.get('event') == 'tool_executed' and event.get('name') == 'run_shell'); assert 'return a + b' in text; assert shell_count >= 2; assert ledger['failing_evidence']; assert ledger['passing_evidence']; assert ledger['verify_required'] is False"

setup.last_failure: calculator add regression still failing after first attempted repair
